integrity: An analytic proof is given. Finite cross-checks supplement, but do not replace, the proof. Scientific originality is qualified by unindexed-prior-work risk.
scientific_limitations: Common-width rectangular pulses; all unordered midpoint channels separated by more than their pulse length; only fixed-parameter O(1) and symmetric sharp cutoff; no results for overlapping midpoint channels or smoothed negativity.
title: Exact logarithmic Wigner negativity of midpoint-separated rectangular pulse trains
